newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Commission President Jacques Santer and Commissioner Mario Monti would hold a joint news conference on the "Citizens First" programme at 1200/1100 GMT on Tuesday.

Spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi briefed on Tueday's Internal Market Council. She said discussions would focus on Commissioner Monti's communication on the impact and efficiency of the single market and on the proposal for a directive on legal protection of designs and models. She said the ministers would interrupt the meeting at 1215/1115 GMT to attend the launch of the information campaign on "Citizens First".
Spokesman Peter Guilford said a trade agreement had been reached Saturday morning between the EU and the Korean authorities on opening their telecoms markets.

Guilford also briefed on trade discussions at the General Affairs Council. He said the second phase of textile market liberalisation under the Uruguay Round has been agreed. He also said the Commission had received a mandate to negotiate an Information Technology Agreement as well as backing on the draft conclusions of the Singapore WTO inter-ministerial meeting and the EU position on China's accession to the WTO.

Van der Pas read a declaration by Commissioner Neil Kinnock on the French truck drivers' strike in which he expressed his hope for a quick solution and underlined that certain working conditions that pose problems are currently subject to community regulations.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1068: Statement by President Santer and Mr. de Silguy.
- IP/96/1069: Internal market: action programme to improve the application of Community law.
- IP/96/1071: Euro-Mediterranean partnership: conference on local water management.
- IP/96/1072: European information technology conference and exhibition 1996.
- IP/96/1073: Breakthrough opens $6 billion Korean telecoms market to European business.
- IP/96/1074: Commission welcomes Council agreement on removal of textile quotas under GATT rules
- Speech/96/300: Speech by Commissioner Manuel Marin at India investment and trade co-operation forum.
- Speech/96/301: Speech in the name of Commission President Jacques Santer at the European finance convention.
- News release on Italy's decision to reintegrate the European Monetary System.
